summary: resolvePacketRoute now derives one availability word per route (PACKET_READY | CUSTOM_PLEADING_READY | GUIDANCE_READY | HANDOFF_READY | MAINTENANCE_HOLD | LEGAL_HOLD | UNFINISHED) plus a new fail-closed routeKind 'handoff' for referral / attorney-review contracts, carried per row into the launch graph with totals and per-state counts. Zero routes are ready — the correct fail-closed initial output against today's registry (7 v1 records + 1 v2 record, none admissible). Availability is reporting, never rollout: sellable and creditConsumable are untouched, the ready states are reachable only through a Grade-A record at the admission schema version read through the existing loader, and the nationwide flip stays with consumer-delivery-control under the all-51 launch rule.

designNotes.handoffRouteKind: Contracts with outcomeMode referral or attorney_review_packet resolve routeKind 'handoff' (rendererKind none, sellable false, creditConsumable false) with handoffTo in the controlling-decision vocabulary (attorney_or_prosecutor | retained_counsel). Eleven contracts are affected (9 MS, MN cannabis 609A.055(6), RI path-g); 3 of them sit in the intended-paid denominator and now report HANDOFF_READY.
designNotes.maintenanceCarriers: MAINTENANCE_HOLD derives only from existing carriers: the resolver's own packet_correction_required finding, the problematic-PDF register the launch graph's pdfStatus.hold reads (matched by the resolution's own track ids), em1's route-holds.json ledger (absent = no holds; present-but-malformed = hold everything it cannot parse, per the carrier's contract), and — for otherwise-proven routes only — a non-live ConsumerDeliveryRouteState or an unpinned deploymentReadiness block.
designNotes.legalCarriers: LEGAL_HOLD derives from routeCheckoutIsClosed on the approved contract, treatmentReviewState pending_independent_review, and unreleased LEGAL_HOLD rows in route-holds.json. The OR acquittal route reports LEGAL_HOLD (its closed contract outranks its v2 fulfillment record).
designNotes.gradeAReadOnly: The ready branch calls fulfillmentAuthorityFor / getCurrentFulfillmentRecord (the existing loader inside src/lib/rcap/fulfillment/) read-only and requires state COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN at schema rcap-grade-a-fulfillment-authority/v2. No second commercial decision; governCommercialAdmission is not called; lane-F still finds exactly one governed call site per admission point (52/52).
designNotes.flavour: CUSTOM_PLEADING_READY vs PACKET_READY is read from the registered packet specification's document outputStrategy (custom_pleading vs official_pdf_fill), falling back to whether the factory packet sets name official form ids.
